lines.text: The Teacher saw wickedness in the place of judgment and righteousness, and said God will judge the righteous and the wicked.
God tests men to show they are but beasts, since men and beasts share the same fate and all return to dust.
The Teacher saw nothing better for a man than to enjoy his work, because that is his lot.
The Teacher saw the tears of the oppressed, who had no comforter, while the power lay with their oppressors.
He admired the living above the dead, but said better than both is he who has not yet existed.

wrong_details.true: the dead, who had already died, above the living
